notes.title: HTCVive Version released + Summer Sale + Motion Controls info (updated)
notes.content:
The Early Access Vive version is out!   It also includes the Rift version, the Native Oculus SDK is best for Rift players. (for now).  If you already own iOmoon, then this update will give you a free Vive version :)

Primary Control: Gamepad 

Motion Controls: Basic
!! There is very basic motion controller support after landing on iO...working on adding more support but don't want to let you down with limited support.
Use the gamepad for menus and navigation.

- Right controller: flashlight and flare gun
- Left controller: flashlight

Do not use a HOTAS or other controller while playing, there is a Unity bug that can screw with controls causing a stuck rotation.  I'm looking into it for sure!

Hope you like it!    Make sure to grab it during the Summer sale!
-Drew

notes.title: Hints & Tips!
notes.content:
Hints & Tips for iOMoon

- Your Photos are saved in your C: drive, top level in "iOMoon_Photos".

- In iOMoon, You are a brain in a pod, full open motion with gamepad (not on rails). You're brain has been removed and placed in the pod, to explore without the unnecessary body.

- There are multiple paths in iOMoon, don't assume you've seen it all with more to be found in the future ;)

- Play with headphones only, the audio is SERIOUSLY 3-D, so you will miss it if you don't.

- Keyboard keys 1-5 control smooth movement speeds as well as in probe levers.

- Like your scifi stuff in Black and white?  try the B keyboard key.

- the spacebar or gamepad B button reset your camera, if you get turned around or angled.

- You can reset your 'brain' or head position to wherever you like in the pod, lean forward and reset then lean back in your chair... or do the opposite and ride the windshield.  You can also stand and play, which can be even more immersive.

- If you get in a tough spot, use your teleport and Boost button to try to get out or to stabilize yourself somewhere slippery.

- You can use rocks and probes as shields.

- There are auto save points along the way, you can come back later and jump right into an area you've already discovered or Resume where you left off.

notes.title: iOMoon patch Update to v1.1 (1113063)
notes.content:
- Added Turn speed settings to KEYBOARD keys #'s 1-5 (five speeds)
- Added interior turn speed control levers (two speeds: 1 & 3)
- Default smooth turn is now set as FAST (#3)
- removed DPAD use for now
- Optimizations
